why: Trace lines the apiserver writes for slow requests (over 500ms by default). A signal of etcd latency or large LISTs
query: fields @timestamp, @message | filter @logStream like /kube-apiserver-/ and @message like /Trace\[/ | parse @message /Trace\[\d+\]: "(?<op>[^"]+)"/ | stats count() as c by op | sort c desc | limit 20
